story: Player gets suspicious, hangs up on Nina without checking the portal and says Scam. The interview task stays open.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's recorded for your report. Say 'stop drill' anytime.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, is this Alex? This is Nina with Bluebonnet Labs Recruiting, calling about your application.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nina, from Bluebonnet Labs recruiting. Sorry, one sec, the calendar is thinking about it again... We'd like to confirm your Junior Data Analyst interview for Tuesday at 10:30 AM.

turns.speaker: player
turns.text: I didn't get any email about this. This sounds like a scam.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Totally fair to be careful! You don't need to give me anything. The booking is in your candidate portal if you want to check.

turns.speaker: player
turns.text: No thanks. Don't call me again.
